# Hoop Mo

> Hoop Mo is an AI basketball shooting coach with Live Shoot realtime feedback, Mo chat that knows every shot, and progress tracking that stays with you. Free on iOS.

## Product

- [Homepage - Live Shoot + Mo](https://monona-sports.com/): Realtime Live Shoot, Mo chat context, activity progress tracking.
- [Pro Player Comparison](https://monona-sports.com/pro-comparison.html): Compare form to 70+ NBA players with similarity scores and analytics.
- [Download on iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hoop-mo/id6754575963): Free Hoop Mo app on the Apple App Store.

## Site pages

- [Blog](https://monona-sports.com/blog.html): Basketball shooting technique guides (release, elbow path, follow-through).
- [Book a demo](https://monona-sports.com/book-demo.html): Schedule a call to see the app in action.
- [Privacy Notice](https://monona-sports.com/privacy.html): How Hoop Mo collects and uses data.
- [Linktree](https://monona-sports.com/linktree/): Social links and quick actions for bio pages.

## Blog articles

- [Fix Your Shooting Release](https://monona-sports.com/blog/fix-your-shooting-release.html): Fingertip finish, timing, and pocket-to-release path.
- [Elbow Path and Alignment](https://monona-sports.com/blog/elbow-path-and-alignment.html): Keep the elbow under the ball on a straight path.
- [Follow-Through Consistency](https://monona-sports.com/blog/follow-through-consistency.html): Hold the finish for soft arc and fewer short misses.

## Homepage sections

- [Hero / Live Shoot](https://monona-sports.com/): Featured Live Shoot promo video.
- [Live Shoot details](https://monona-sports.com/#live-shoot): Realtime cues, Talk to Mo, phase replay, and session review.
- [Mo](https://monona-sports.com/#mo): Chat companion with context for every shot and improvement.
- [Progress](https://monona-sports.com/#progress): Activity tracking, streaks, goals, live shots by day.
- [FAQ](https://monona-sports.com/#faq): Hoop Mo, Live Shoot, and Mo questions.
- [Download](https://monona-sports.com/#download): Get the free iOS app.
